_comment: Integrator configurations run through the gates. A configuration is a list of JSBSim properties set after the initial conditions are loaded and before RunIC, plus which source it runs on (unpatched = JSBSim v1.3.3 as released; patched = plus wasm/patches/*.patch). New candidates may be ADDED here; the gates themselves (gates.json) may not change.

ref-default.role: reference (harness check only, known answer from REVIEW-codex-02): JSBSim's defaults

ref-ab4.role: reference (harness check only, known answer from REVIEW-codex-02): AB4 body rates, known to fail on the ground

floor.role: FLOOR: JSBSim's default body rates (Euler) plus Buss 2 attitude. No patch. The fallback if nothing else passes.

c1-ab4.role: CANDIDATE 1: integrator-aware friction (patch 0001, mode 1) with AB4 body rates and Buss 2 attitude

c1-ab3.role: CANDIDATE 1 variant: integrator-aware friction (mode 1) with AB3 body rates and Buss 2 attitude

c1-ab2.role: CANDIDATE 1 variant: integrator-aware friction (mode 1) with AB2 body rates and Buss 2 attitude

c1-euler.role: Comparison: the floor's integrators (Euler body rates, Buss 2) with integrator-aware friction on (it then only changes how friction treats translation, which JSBSim integrates with AB2)

c1x-ab4-2010formula.role: Comparison only: the 2010 code's formula (patch 0001, mode 2) with AB4 body rates and Buss 2 attitude

c2-mid.role: CANDIDATE 2: implicit-midpoint body rates (patch 0002, PteroLabsAI/jsbsim PR 13) with Buss 2 attitude; friction as in JSBSim

c2-mid-fa.role: CANDIDATE 2 with integrator-aware friction (patch 0001, mode 1): implicit-midpoint body rates, Buss 2 attitude

c3-ab4.role: CANDIDATE 3: AB4 body rates in the air, Euler while any contact point touches (patch 0003), Buss 2 attitude; friction as in JSBSim

c3-ab4-fa.role: CANDIDATE 3 with integrator-aware friction (patch 0001, mode 1): AB4 in the air, Euler on contact, Buss 2 attitude

c3-ab3.role: CANDIDATE 3 variant: AB3 body rates in the air, Euler while any contact point touches, Buss 2 attitude; friction as in JSBSim

c3-ab3-fa.role: CANDIDATE 3 variant with integrator-aware friction (mode 1): AB3 in the air, Euler on contact, Buss 2 attitude

c3x-ab4-fa-hold.role: Comparison (the switch itself): c3-ab4-fa, but the on-contact scheme is kept for 0.1 s after the last contact

c3x-ab4-fa-keep.role: Comparison (the switch itself): c3-ab4-fa, but the multistep history is kept on release (contact-release-mode 0), not restarted

ref05-ground-unpatched.role: SESSION 05 REFERENCE for ground cases (9600 Hz): JSBSim's Euler body rates with Buss 2 attitude, unpatched source

ref05-ground-patched.role: SESSION 05 REFERENCE for ground cases (9600 Hz): the same on the patched source, every patch switched off

ref05-flight-unpatched.role: SESSION 05 REFERENCE for flight cases (9600 Hz): AB4 body rates with Buss 2 attitude, unpatched source

ref05-flight-patched.role: SESSION 05 REFERENCE for flight cases (9600 Hz): the same on the patched source

ref-default-05.role: reference (harness check only): JSBSim's defaults on the patched source, through the session 05 gates at 1000 Hz
